refnamediv.refpurpose: Gets the arguments passed to the attribute

refentry.refsect1:
&reftitle.description;
public arrayReflectionAttribute::getArguments
Gets the arguments passed to the attribute.
The arguments are constant expressions and are evaluated when this method is called. Evaluating an argument may autoload a class referenced by the expression, for example through a class constant, an enum case, or an object created with new. Reading the arguments does not require the attribute class to exist, and does not validate the arguments against its constructor.

&reftitle.returnvalues;
The arguments passed to the attribute.

&reftitle.errors;
If evaluating an argument throws an error or exception, it is propagated. This can happen when the argument references a class that cannot be loaded, or a constant that is not defined.
